description: Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures - 11 recommended disclosures across 4 pillars

Governance.description: Disclose the organization's governance around climate-related risks and opportunities.

recommendations.title: Board oversight
recommendations.description: Describe the board's oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities.
requirements: Board body that oversees climate issues and how often it is informed
Board considers climate issues in strategy, budgets, risk appetite and major plans
Board monitors progress against climate goals and targets

criteria.text: Board body that oversees climate issues and how often it is informed
criteria.query: The board or a board committee is informed about climate-related risks and opportunities at its regular quarterly meetings

signals.name: board body
signals.pattern: \bboard\b|board[- ]level|directors|audit (?:and|&) risk committee|risk (?:management )?committee of the board|sustainability committee|supervisory board

criteria.missing: Name the board or board committee responsible for climate oversight and state how often it is briefed on climate-related issues.

criteria.text: Board considers climate issues in strategy, budgets, risk appetite and major plans
criteria.query: The board considers climate-related issues when reviewing and guiding strategy, budgets, business plans, risk appetite and major investment decisions

signals.name: board body
signals.pattern: \bboard\b|board[- ]level|directors|audit (?:and|&) risk committee|risk (?:management )?committee of the board|sustainability committee|supervisory board

criteria.missing: Explain whether and how the board takes climate-related issues into account when approving strategy, budgets, risk appetite and major investments.

criteria.text: Board monitors progress against climate goals and targets
criteria.query: The board monitors and oversees progress against climate-related goals and targets

signals.name: board body
signals.pattern: \bboard\b|board[- ]level|directors|audit (?:and|&) risk committee|risk (?:management )?committee of the board|sustainability committee|supervisory board

criteria.missing: Describe how the board monitors progress against the organisation's climate-related goals and targets.

recommendations.title: Management's role
recommendations.description: Describe management's role in assessing and managing climate-related risks and opportunities.
requirements: Climate responsibilities assigned to management roles or committees
Organisational structure and reporting lines for climate issues
How management is informed about and monitors climate issues

criteria.text: Climate responsibilities assigned to management roles or committees
criteria.query: Named management positions or committees, such as the chief risk officer, a sustainability committee or the risk management function, are responsible for climate-related issues

signals.name: management role
signals.pattern: (?:(?:senior |executive )?management (?:committee|team|council|board|body|level)|management-level|executive (?:committee|management|director)|chief [a-z]+ officer|\bc[efrs]o\b|vice[- ]president|head of [a-z]+|managing director|steering (?:committee|group)|working group|(?:sustainability|esg|climate|csr)[a-z &]{0,25}(?:committee|council|team|cell|officer|lead|function)|(?:enterprise )?risk management (?:\(erm\) )?function|risk (?:management )?committee|\bmanagers?\b)(?! of the board| of directors)

criteria.missing: Identify which management-level positions or committees are responsible for assessing and managing climate-related issues.

criteria.text: Organisational structure and reporting lines for climate issues
criteria.query: The management structure for climate issues, which committee or officer reports to whom, chairs and reporting lines

signals.name: management role
signals.pattern: (?:(?:senior |executive )?management (?:committee|team|council|board|body|level)|management-level|executive (?:committee|management|director)|chief [a-z]+ officer|\bc[efrs]o\b|vice[- ]president|head of [a-z]+|managing director|steering (?:committee|group)|working group|(?:sustainability|esg|climate|csr)[a-z &]{0,25}(?:committee|council|team|cell|officer|lead|function)|(?:enterprise )?risk management (?:\(erm\) )?function|risk (?:management )?committee|\bmanagers?\b)(?! of the board| of directors)

signals.name: structure
signals.pattern: reports? (?:directly )?to|reporting line|chaired by|\bchair\b|members? of|comprises|lines? of defen[cs]e|organi[sz]ational structure|escalat|structure

criteria.missing: Describe the organisational structure for climate issues: who reports to whom, committee chairs and escalation to the board.

criteria.text: How management is informed about and monitors climate issues
criteria.query: Management committees are regularly informed about and monitor climate-related issues through reports and meetings

signals.name: management role
signals.pattern: (?:(?:senior |executive )?management (?:committee|team|council|board|body|level)|management-level|executive (?:committee|management|director)|chief [a-z]+ officer|\bc[efrs]o\b|vice[- ]president|head of [a-z]+|managing director|steering (?:committee|group)|working group|(?:sustainability|esg|climate|csr)[a-z &]{0,25}(?:committee|council|team|cell|officer|lead|function)|(?:enterprise )?risk management (?:\(erm\) )?function|risk (?:management )?committee|\bmanagers?\b)(?! of the board| of directors)

signals.name: frequency or process
signals.pattern: quarterl|annual(?:ly)?|bi-?annual|semi-annual|monthly|fortnightly|weekly|each (?:board )?meeting|every (?:board )?meeting|at least (?:once|twice|\w+ times)|times (?:a|per) year|regular(?:ly)?|periodic|met \w+ times|convened \w+|process|dashboard|key risk indicator|\bkri

criteria.missing: Explain how and how often management is informed about climate-related issues and how it monitors them.

Strategy.description: Disclose the actual and potential impacts of climate-related risks and opportunities on the organization's businesses, strategy, and financial planning where such information is material.

recommendations.title: Climate risks and opportunities
recommendations.description: Describe the climate-related risks and opportunities the organization has identified over the short, medium, and long term.
requirements: Short-, medium- and long-term horizons defined
Specific climate-related risks identified (physical and/or transition)
Climate-related opportunities identified
Process for determining which risks and opportunities are material

criteria.text: Short-, medium- and long-term horizons defined
criteria.query: The organisation defines short-term, medium-term and long-term time horizons in years for climate-related risks
criteria.missing: Define the short-, medium- and long-term time horizons (in years) used for climate-related risks and opportunities.

criteria.text: Specific climate-related risks identified (physical and/or transition)
criteria.query: Specific climate-related physical risks such as floods, droughts and extreme weather and transition risks such as carbon pricing, regulation and stranded assets

signals.name: specific risk
signals.pattern: physical risk|transition risk|flood|drought|cyclone|heat ?wave|heat stress|wildfire|sea[- ]level|extreme weather|carbon pric|carbon tax|regulat|stranded|cbam|litigation|reputation|technology risk|market risk|demand

criteria.missing: List the specific physical and transition risks identified and the time horizon over which each could have a material financial impact.

criteria.text: Climate-related opportunities identified
criteria.query: Climate-related opportunities such as green finance, low-carbon products, renewable energy, energy efficiency and new markets
criteria.missing: Describe the climate-related opportunities identified (e.g. products, markets, resource efficiency, energy sources).

criteria.text: Process for determining which risks and opportunities are material
criteria.query: The process used to determine which climate-related risks and opportunities could have a material financial impact
criteria.missing: Describe the process used to determine which climate-related risks and opportunities could have a material financial impact.

recommendations.title: Business and financial impact
recommendations.description: Describe the impact of climate-related risks and opportunities on the organization's businesses, strategy, and financial planning.
requirements: Impact on businesses, products, operations or portfolio
Climate issues as an input to financial planning
Impact on financial performance and position

criteria.text: Impact on businesses, products, operations or portfolio
criteria.query: Climate-related risks and opportunities affect the organisation's products, services, operations, supply chain, investment portfolio and clients
criteria.missing: Describe how climate-related risks and opportunities affect products and services, supply chain, operations, R&D and investments.

criteria.text: Climate issues as an input to financial planning
criteria.query: Climate-related issues are an input to financial planning, budgets, capital allocation and capital expenditure

signals.name: financial planning
signals.pattern: financial planning|budget|capital allocation|capital expenditure|capex|opex|operating cost|cost of capital|access to capital|financial plan|business plan|implementation plan|investment plan|resourc|funding|pricing|provision

criteria.missing: Explain how climate-related issues feed into financial planning (operating costs, revenues, capital expenditure, capital allocation).

criteria.text: Impact on financial performance and position
criteria.query: The quantified impact of climate-related risks and opportunities on revenues, costs, asset values, credit losses and financial position
criteria.missing: Disclose the (ideally quantified) effect of climate-related risks and opportunities on financial performance and financial position.

recommendations.title: Organisational resilience
recommendations.description: Describe the resilience of the organization's strategy, taking into consideration different climate-related scenarios, including a 2°C or lower scenario.
requirements: Climate scenarios used, named
A 2°C-or-lower scenario included, with temperature assumptions
Results: how the strategy holds up under the scenarios

criteria.text: Climate scenarios used, named
criteria.query: Climate scenario analysis using named scenarios such as NGFS, IEA, RCP or SSP pathways
criteria.missing: Name the climate-related scenarios used (e.g. NGFS, IEA, RCP/SSP pathways) and their time horizons.

criteria.text: A 2°C-or-lower scenario included, with temperature assumptions
criteria.query: A scenario limiting warming to 2 degrees Celsius or lower, such as 1.5°C or net zero 2050
criteria.missing: Include a 2°C-or-lower scenario and state its temperature assumption.

criteria.text: Results: how the strategy holds up under the scenarios
criteria.query: Results of the scenario analysis or climate stress test and what they mean for the resilience of the strategy

signals.name: findings
signals.pattern: resilience of (?:the|our|its) (?:strategy|business|portfolio|operations)|strategy (?:is|remains|would remain) resilient|results? (?:show|indicate|suggest|of the)|findings|outcomes? (?:show|indicate|of)|non-performing|\bnpl|(?:credit |expected )?loss(?:es)? (?:of|would|could)|financial impact|impact (?:on|of) [^.]{0,40}(?:revenue|portfolio|ebitda|profit|assets?|earnings|operations)|would (?:reduce|increase|result|lead)|(?:could|would) be (?:material|limited|significant)|\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s?(?:%|per ?cent)

criteria.missing: Report the results of the scenario analysis and explain how resilient the strategy is and how it might change.

Risk Management.description: Disclose how the organization identifies, assesses, and manages climate-related risks.

recommendations.title: Risk identification and assessment
recommendations.description: Describe the organization's processes for identifying and assessing climate-related risks.
requirements: Process for identifying and assessing climate risks
How the significance of climate risks is determined
Existing and emerging regulation considered

criteria.text: Process for identifying and assessing climate risks
criteria.query: The process, framework or methodology used to identify, screen and assess climate-related risks
criteria.missing: Describe the processes, tools and methodologies used to identify and assess climate-related risks.

criteria.text: How the significance of climate risks is determined
criteria.query: How the organisation determines the relative significance or materiality of climate-related risks using likelihood, magnitude, ratings or thresholds
criteria.missing: Explain how the relative significance of climate-related risks is determined compared with other risks.

criteria.text: Existing and emerging regulation considered
criteria.query: Existing and emerging climate regulation, carbon pricing and disclosure requirements are considered in the risk assessment
criteria.missing: State whether existing and emerging regulatory requirements related to climate change are considered.

recommendations.title: Risk management processes
recommendations.description: Describe the organization's processes for managing climate-related risks.
requirements: Decisions to mitigate, transfer, accept or control climate risks
How climate risks are prioritised (appetite, limits, thresholds)
How climate risks are monitored and controlled

criteria.text: Decisions to mitigate, transfer, accept or control climate risks
criteria.query: Specific actions to mitigate, transfer, accept or control climate-related risks, such as exposure limits, insurance, exclusions, adaptation measures or controls
criteria.missing: Describe how decisions are made to mitigate, transfer, accept or control climate-related risks.

criteria.text: How climate risks are prioritised (appetite, limits, thresholds)
criteria.query: How climate-related risks are prioritised, for example through risk appetite, exposure limits or tolerance thresholds
criteria.missing: Explain how climate-related risks are prioritised, including risk appetite, limits or thresholds.

criteria.text: How climate risks are monitored and controlled
criteria.query: Climate-related risks are monitored and controlled through key risk indicators, reviews and reporting
criteria.missing: Describe how climate-related risks are monitored over time and reported.

recommendations.title: Integration into overall risk management
recommendations.description: Describe how processes for identifying, assessing, and managing climate-related risks are integrated into the organization's overall risk management.
requirements: Climate risk processes integrated into overall risk management

criteria.text: Climate risk processes integrated into overall risk management
criteria.query: Climate-related risk management is integrated into the existing enterprise risk management framework, risk appetite and principal risks

signals.name: enterprise framework
signals.pattern: enterprise[- ](?:wide )?risk|\berm\b|(?:existing|overall|group|bank's|company's|corporate) risk management|risk management (?:framework|process|system)|risk appetite|risk taxonomy|principal risks|risk register|icaap|three lines

criteria.missing: Describe how climate-related risk processes are integrated into the organisation's overall (enterprise) risk management.

Metrics & Targets.description: Disclose the metrics and targets used to assess and manage relevant climate-related risks and opportunities where such information is material.

recommendations.title: Climate-related metrics
recommendations.description: Disclose the metrics used by the organization to assess climate-related risks and opportunities in line with its strategy and risk management process.
requirements: Climate metrics reported with actual values
Climate metrics linked to remuneration
Internal carbon price or climate-opportunity metrics

criteria.text: Climate metrics reported with actual values
criteria.query: Climate-related metrics with reported values such as emission intensity, energy consumption, renewable share, exposure to carbon-related assets or green finance volumes
criteria.missing: Report the climate-related metrics used, with their values (and units) for the reporting period.

criteria.text: Climate metrics linked to remuneration
criteria.query: Whether climate-related performance metrics are incorporated into executive remuneration or incentive schemes
criteria.missing: State whether and how climate-related performance metrics are incorporated into remuneration policies.

criteria.text: Internal carbon price or climate-opportunity metrics
criteria.query: An internal or shadow carbon price, or metrics on climate-related opportunities such as green revenue or climate finance

signals.name: price or opportunity metric
signals.pattern: internal carbon pric|shadow (?:carbon )?pric|carbon pric|green revenue|green finance|sustainable finance|climate finance|revenue from|low[- ]carbon (?:products|revenue)

criteria.missing: Where relevant, disclose an internal carbon price and metrics on climate-related opportunities (e.g. green revenue).

recommendations.title: Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions
recommendations.description: Disclose Scope 1, Scope 2, and, if appropriate, Scope 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and the related risks.
requirements: Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions with values
Scope 3 emissions (incl. financed emissions where relevant)
Emissions methodology
Historical emissions for trend analysis

criteria.text: Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions with values
criteria.query: Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions in tonnes of CO2 equivalent
criteria.missing: Disclose Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions in tCO2e for the reporting period.

criteria.text: Scope 3 emissions (incl. financed emissions where relevant)
criteria.query: Scope 3 greenhouse gas emissions, including financed emissions for financial institutions
criteria.missing: Disclose Scope 3 emissions (for financial institutions, financed emissions) and which categories are covered.

criteria.text: Emissions methodology
criteria.query: Emissions are calculated using the GHG Protocol or PCAF methodology with location-based and market-based approaches

signals.name: methodology
signals.pattern: ghg protocol|greenhouse gas protocol|pcaf|iso 14064|methodolog|location[- ]based|market[- ]based|emission factor|operational control|equity share|calculated (?:using|in accordance)

criteria.missing: State the methodology used to calculate emissions (e.g. GHG Protocol, PCAF) and the consolidation approach.

criteria.text: Historical emissions for trend analysis
criteria.query: Emissions reported for several years so trends can be analysed
criteria.missing: Report emissions for prior years (and a base year) so trends can be analysed.

recommendations.title: Climate targets and performance
recommendations.description: Describe the targets used by the organization to manage climate-related risks and opportunities and performance against targets.
requirements: Quantified climate targets
Target time frame (deadline)
Base year for targets
Performance and progress against targets

criteria.text: Quantified climate targets
criteria.query: Quantified climate-related targets with a target year, such as a 20% reduction in energy or power consumption, emission reduction targets, net zero, renewable energy share or green finance by 2030
criteria.missing: Disclose quantified climate-related targets (e.g. GHG reduction, energy, green finance).

criteria.text: Target time frame (deadline)
criteria.query: Climate targets with a deadline: to be achieved by 2025, by 2030 or by 2050, or over a period such as between 2021 and 2025

signals.name: deadline
signals.pattern: \bby (?:the end of )?(?:fy\s?)?20[2-6]\d|until 20[2-6]\d|\b20[2-6]\d (?:target|goal)|(?:target|goal) (?:year|date)|between 20[0-6]\d and 20[2-6]\d|within \w+ years|over the next \w+ years|(?:goals?|targets?) (?:for |by )?20[2-6]\d

criteria.missing: State the time frame (target year) for each climate-related target.

criteria.text: Base year for targets
criteria.query: The base year or baseline against which climate targets are measured
criteria.missing: State the base year against which each target is measured.

criteria.text: Performance and progress against targets
criteria.query: Actual performance and progress achieved against the climate targets in the reporting period

signals.name: progress
signals.pattern: progress|achiev|reached|performance against|on track|reduced by|reduction of|so far|to date|delivered|met (?:the|its|our)|within target|status

criteria.missing: Report actual performance against each target in the reporting period and progress to date.

metadata.source: TCFD Final Report (2017), Recommendations of the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures
metadata.criteria_note: Each criterion is supported when a retrieved passage is semantically relevant and contains every listed evidence signal. Non-essential criteria count towards evidence coverage but do not block a Compliant status.
